dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from thin, high-intensity exterior lines to dark centers, distributed primarily across the dorsal mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of localized, solid light-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, interspersed between the primary ring structures in the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral with a distinct obtuse angle at the most anterior-superior point.
